subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II / bridge letter to complete Finova procurement
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finova.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@finova.com, Tom Liu <tom.liu@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement is moving quickly and I need to close the security checklist to keep us on track for the Sep 30 pilot kickoff. Can you please share: 1) the latest SOC 2 Type II report (audit period requested: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) or 2) a bridge letter or attestation if the Type II is still in flight?

If a bridge letter is possible, we need wording confirming the controls in scope and the audit period covered, plus a short index of evidence locations. Ideally we’d have the bridge letter by Sep 22 to complete our procurement review.

Attaching the RFP/security questionnaire for context (small excerpt attached). Let me know if a one-page checklist or FAQ would help.

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Director, IT Procurement
Finova Bank

Attachment: Finova_RFP.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Vivek / Neha — forwarding Finova request. They want a SOC 2 Type II (2025 calendar year) or a bridge letter by Sep 22 to unblock procurement (pilot kickoff targeted Sep 30). Deal: DEAL-4821, Finova Bank.

Can we commit to producing a bridge letter + evidence index by EOD Sep 22? If not, what is the quickest realistic delivery cadence? This is time-sensitive — procurement is the gating item. Marcus, can engineering pull the control evidence lists Vivek will need?

Short answers appreciated so I can update Elena.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Rachel — thanks for the flag. Short version: we do not yet have a finalized Type II report for 2025 available to share; the audit is in progress and the auditor’s final report is expected Q4. However, we can produce a formal bridge letter that: 1) confirms the audit period and scope, 2) describes the current state of controls as of a specific date, and 3) references an evidence index.

Proposed internal plan & timeline (target):
- Today (Sep 20): Laura drafts bridge letter language and the generic template (uses SOC2-bridge-letter-template.docx).
- Sep 21 morning: Marcus extracts evidence artifacts for in-scope control families (access logs, change control tickets, patching cadence records) and produces an evidence-index.csv.
- Sep 22 EOD: Finalize bridge letter signed by Security/Legal and provide evidence index + a short explanatory note for procurement.

Risks: full Type II report will not be ready by Sep 22; if procurement insists on the final auditor report we will need an extension. Also need Neha to review wording for any legal exposure.

Marcus — can you confirm you have ETA to extract logs (list below) and whether we need anything from infra or from the third-party monitoring account?

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Vivek / Rachel — I can extract the artifacts. ETA: initial evidence-index.csv with pointers to S3 buckets and ticket links by Sep 21 12:00 PM PT. Items I will include:
- Access control logs (auth service) — last 12 months
- Change control tickets (Jira project INFRA-CHG) — linked tickets
- Patch management summary (package manager reports)
- Backup verification snapshots and retention policy excerpt

If auditors need signed attestation from infra, let me know — otherwise I’ll assemble the index and upload to the drive Vivek creates.

-Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Team — I’ll take the first pass at the bridge letter wording. Notes:
- We can confirm the audit period (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) and list the control categories in scope (CCM/Trust Services Criteria: Security, Availability, Confidentiality).
- Bridge letters must avoid implying the audit is complete — we should state the audit is in progress and provide the date of most recent control observation.
- I will coordinate with our auditor (Crowe LLP) to ensure wording is acceptable.

I’ll draft the letter and upload along with an evidence index template (evidence-index-template.csv) to the shared drive. Expect initial drafts by Sep 22 morning.

Laura Bennett
Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2-bridge-letter-template.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-FINOVA
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finova.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@finova.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request + audit period clarification

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the RFP excerpt — appreciate the urgency. Quick update on timing and deliverables to keep procurement moving:

- Bridge letter: We will provide a signed bridge letter that confirms the audit period (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31), the Trust Services Criteria in scope (Security, Availability, Confidentiality), and a statement that the Type II audit is currently in progress. Delivery: Sep 22 EOD PT.
- Evidence index: initial evidence-index.csv with artifact locations (S3/Jira/Drive pointers) delivered Sep 21 noon PT; final index will accompany the bridge letter on Sep 22.
- Type II final report: expected Q4 when the auditor issues the final report. If Finova requires the auditor’s final report rather than a bridge letter, please let us know and we’ll request procurement extension but cannot guarantee a Q3 delivery.

If you need specific control artifacts to be attached to the response packet, tell us which control IDs in your questionnaire are most critical and Marcus will prioritize.

Appreciate your flexibility — we’ll get the bridge letter and index to you by Sep 22.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
